subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.epw@energyplus` is this plugin's own self-contained EnergyPlus EPW weather file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-location, set-design-conditions, set-typical-extreme-periods, set-ground-temperatures, set-holidays-dst, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
